column1: # Antigens with measurable effects in published trials. These must surface in
# the top tier on deterministic evidence alone, which is why the literature
# stage is blinded for this run.
# protein_id values are accessions in GCF_016086655.4 (UVic_Lsal_1.4). They
# were established by aligning a UniProt reference for each antigen against
# that proteome -- not by matching annotation text, which does not work here:
# RefSeq names P0 "large ribosomal subunit protein uL10", so no search for
# "P0" finds it, and two unrelated proteins are both called "peroxiredoxin 2".
# Reproduce with scripts/map_controls.py.
# identity_pct and coverage describe the alignment to mapped_from. Rows
# commented out below could not be mapped; they are excluded rather than
# guessed, so the gate measures only controls that actually resolve.
